regressions.issue: Two pointers read from mem[64] with no write between (_982, _983) are not identified, so the abi.encode length mem[_983] (128) is unknown: the argument copy stays a loop (+1 while), validatePolicies and balanceOf print raw, both error strings are built in memory, SharesBought logs raw memory and the return is 'return memory'. The scratch writes 'mem[0] = _8 / mem[32] = 3' are now printed too, as if they could alias the event data. All of this was decoded in round 1.
regressions.rule: Values read from mem[64] between two writes to it are equal (and equal to mem[64]); use the floor of mem[64] to prove that writes to mem[0..63] do not alias data at mem[64] + k, so the event, error and return decode as before.
